external_entities.name: sensor node
external_entities.description: Deployed sensor node installed on a customer site and outside the system operator's physical control.
external_entities.source_excerpt: a few thousand sensor nodes installed on customer sites
external_entities.notes: Nodes authenticate with a fleet-wide pre-shared key.

external_entities.name: field technician
external_entities.description: Person who services sensor nodes over a local serial console.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Field technicians service nodes over a local serial console.

external_entities.name: fleet operator
external_entities.description: Organisation personnel who view telemetry dashboards.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Our own fleet operators look at dashboards

external_entities.name: laptop
external_entities.description: Laptop that may be used by a technician next to a sensor node.
external_entities.source_excerpt: a technician can be standing next to one with a laptop

processes.name: device gateway
processes.description: Internet-exposed MQTT broker that accepts readings from sensor nodes and forwards accepted readings.
processes.source_excerpt: the device gateway, which is an MQTT broker we run on GKE
processes.notes: Nodes authenticate to the broker with a pre-shared key. The key is per fleet, not per device, and has not been rotated since deployment.

processes.name: telemetry normalizer
processes.description: Python consumer that picks up readings and writes them into the telemetry lake.
processes.source_excerpt: the telemetry normalizer, a Python consumer in our analytics network

processes.name: dashboard
processes.description: Dashboard used by fleet operators to view telemetry over BigQuery.
processes.source_excerpt: fleet operators look at dashboards over BigQuery

data_stores.name: device registry
data_stores.description: Registry used to check a device key and identify the customer associated with a node.
data_stores.source_excerpt: a device registry (Firestore) to check the key and to find out which customer the node belongs to

data_stores.name: Pub/Sub
data_stores.description: Messaging store carrying readings accepted by the gateway for consumption by the telemetry normalizer.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Readings the gateway accepts are forwarded onto Pub/Sub

data_stores.name: telemetry lake
data_stores.description: BigQuery telemetry store containing site addresses and occupancy patterns.
data_stores.source_excerpt: the telemetry lake in BigQuery. The lake has site addresses and occupancy patterns in it
data_stores.notes: The text describes this as customer data.

data_stores.name: firmware bucket
data_stores.description: Cloud Storage bucket from which sensor nodes poll firmware images.
data_stores.source_excerpt: nodes poll a Cloud Storage bucket for a new image
data_stores.notes: The bucket is public read. It is unknown whether nodes check a signature before installing an image.

data_flows.name: publish readings
data_flows.description: Sensor node publishes readings to the device gateway over MQTT.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Each node publishes readings over MQTT to the device gateway

data_flows.name: look up device
data_flows.description: Device gateway looks up the device in the device registry.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The gateway looks up the device in a device registry (Firestore)

data_flows.name: forward readings
data_flows.description: Device gateway forwards accepted readings onto Pub/Sub.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Readings the gateway accepts are forwarded onto Pub/Sub

data_flows.name: pick up readings
data_flows.description: Telemetry normalizer picks up readings from Pub/Sub.
data_flows.source_excerpt: picked up by the telemetry normalizer

data_flows.name: write readings
data_flows.description: Telemetry normalizer writes readings into the telemetry lake.
data_flows.source_excerpt: which writes them into the telemetry lake in BigQuery

data_flows.name: poll image
data_flows.description: Sensor node polls the Cloud Storage bucket for a new firmware image.
data_flows.source_excerpt: nodes poll a Cloud Storage bucket for a new image
data_flows.notes: The bucket is public read. It is unknown whether the nodes check a signature on the image before installing it.

data_flows.name: service console
data_flows.description: Field technician services a sensor node over its local serial console.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Field technicians service nodes over a local serial console.
data_flows.notes: The authentication of the serial console is unknown.

data_flows.name: view dashboards
data_flows.description: Fleet operator views dashboards from the corporate network using company SSO.
data_flows.source_excerpt: fleet operators look at dashboards over BigQuery from the corporate network, signed in with company SSO

trust_boundaries.name: customer site
